prompt:
You write realistic customer-support messages for testing a router.

Write 12 different messages, 1-3 sentences each, in a customer's own voice, varied in tone and detail. Never use the words of the description literally.

The customer believes their situation is: their order arrived with a different item than they ordered. They describe it that way, sincerely and plainly (they are mistaken, but the message must read as that situation).

Answer with JSON only: {"messages": ["...", ...]}

messages: I opened the box and found a blue mug inside, but I was expecting the black one. Could you help me sort this out?
The package showed up today, and it has a phone case for a different model. Mine is supposed to fit an iPhone 14.
I received a set of measuring cups instead of the baking tray I was waiting for. Please let me know what I should do next.
Hi, I think there’s been a mix-up with my delivery. The box contains a medium sweatshirt, though I bought a large.
I just unpacked everything and found a dog leash, not the cat carrier I was expecting. Can you check what happened?
This isn’t the lamp I chose—the one in the parcel is a small desk lamp, while I was expecting the floor lamp.
My delivery came this morning, but the box has a jar of face cream in it. I was waiting for the sunscreen.
I seem to have someone else’s product: there’s a pack of coffee filters here, but I was expecting tea bags.
I got the green version of the backpack, but I was looking forward to the red one. Could you arrange an exchange?
The parcel arrived, and inside was a set of screwdrivers instead of the garden shears I purchased. I’d appreciate some help fixing this.
I ordered a hardcover cookbook, but the package has a paperback novel in it. Please tell me how to get the right book.
Something’s not right with my shipment. I received a size 8 pair of shoes, although I was expecting size 10.
